pages.title: Where independence enters
pages.text:
Where independence enters
Four identical independent gates must all be open.
Pr(channel open ) = n · n · n · n = n4.
This is a nerve-model example, not the cardiac companion calculation.

pages.title: A waveform is not an excitability model
pages.text:
A waveform is not an excitability model
The construction has no stimulus, gate recovery or computed conduction speed.
It therefore cannot predict premature-stimulus block or reentry.
Multiple-location recordings can test the constant-speed assumption.
Mathematical Cardiology Notes 20 / 20
